question: What is the primary purpose of tele-nursing in healthcare delivery?

options.A: To completely replace bedside hospital nursing
options.B: To deliver nursing care and monitoring using telecommunication technologies
options.C: To diagnose complex surgical conditions independently
options.D: To eliminate the need for physical patient assessments entirely

explanation: Tele-nursing uses telecommunication technologies to extend nursing care, health education, and monitoring to patients remotely. [learn more](GNS212_U4_T12#GNS212_U4_T12_h1)

question: Which of the following is an essential skill for nurses practicing tele-nursing?
explanation: Nurses engaged in tele-nursing need strong technical proficiency and clear communication skills to assess and instruct patients remotely. [learn more](GNS212_U4_T12#GNS212_U4_T12_h1)

question: What technological advancement significantly accelerated modern tele-nursing practices?

options.B: Smartphones, high-speed internet, and wearable devices
options.C: The introduction of paper patient charts

explanation: Modern tele-nursing relies heavily on smartphones, high-speed broadband, and wearable health technologies for effective remote care. [learn more](GNS212_U4_T12#GNS212_U4_T12_h2)

question: What primary healthcare challenge has driven the adoption of tele-nursing in countries like Nigeria?

options.B: Unequal healthcare distribution and provider shortages
options.C: An overabundance of available physicians in rural areas
options.D: Strict bans on mobile phone usage in clinics

explanation: Tele-nursing helps address healthcare access gaps caused by geographical isolation, unequal distribution, and provider shortages. [learn more](GNS212_U4_T12#GNS212_U4_T12_h2)

question: Which of the following is an example of a Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) tool used in tele-nursing?

options.B: A digital blood pressure cuff transmitting data

question: Why is EHR integration important in tele-nursing platforms?

options.B: It replaces the need for nurses to communicate with physicians

question: What is the primary function of telephone triage in tele-nursing?

options.B: Assessing symptoms and directing patients to the appropriate level of care

question: How is tele-nursing applied in maternal and child health within remote settings?

question: Which regulatory body governs professional nursing practice and standards in Nigeria?

question: Why is data security and encryption critical in tele-nursing practice?
